novelty.new_evidence_axis: New machine-checkable gate shape: use only SEC13F active-flow windows whose quarter-end date is at least 45 calendar days before signal date, explicitly testing the filing-delay PIT weakness disclosed by exp-20260625-010; this does not retune active-holder/value thresholds, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional.

prediction.confidence_reason: The forward active-flow attribution was positive, but exp-20260625-010 already failed Gate 4 before filing-delay hardening and explicitly disclosed quarter-end availability as a PIT weakness. The only reason to run this is to decide whether the lead survives a realistic 13F availability boundary.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing active-flow 13F pair, OHLCV, next open, or 10-session exit bar rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. It only hardens the private historical replay by requiring each SEC13F active-flow window to be at least 45 calendar days past quarter end before a signal can use it. A positive result would still require a shared historical/daily default-off helper and parity tests.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC13F filing-delay-hardened active-manager active-flow candidate pool failed Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high). Do not sweep adjacent active-flow, leadership, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional thresholds on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +1.3417; aggregate PnL delta $+17,561.28; max drawdown drift +0.0406; 312 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry SEC13F active-holder share, active-value share, active-flow deltas, aggregate sponsorship, coownership network, filing-delay offsets, top-N, hold, cooldown, notional, or allocator thresholds on the same frozen windows or the same exp017 partial forward rows.
